component.name: Corestart Reach
component.summary: Manage and open your RDP and SSH connections

description.p: Corestart Reach keeps your remote desktop (RDP) and SSH connections, and the logins for them, in one encrypted vault, and opens any of them with a double-click. It's a simple, modern connection manager in the spirit of mRemoteNG and Royal TS.

ul.li: Everything is encrypted with your master password (Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305)
RDP opens logged in, with clipboard and sound; FreeRDP is included
SSH opens in its own terminal, with passwords, key files, ssh-agent or 2FA prompts
Saved credentials shared by many connections, so a password changes in one place
Quick connect to any host without saving it
Folders with drag and drop, search and keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Free and open source, with no paid version.
